title: Cross-Platform Portability & Pure Vault Hardening

changes.text: Pure In-Vault Key Confinement: Fully decommissioned legacy isValidKeyPath filesystem fallback routines, isolating SSH handshakes strictly to in-memory AES-256-GCM Master PIN decryption.
Decoupled Key Deletion: Hardened CLEAR_KEY sentinel handling so vault keys can be purged independently of active PIN states and protected against merge resurrects.
Universal Runtime Portability: Added dynamic resolveConfigDir supporting Docker (/.dockerenv volume mounts) and Linux desktop/AppImage (XDG ~/.config/bastioncc).
Container Action Visual Cue Suite: Integrated immediate button micro-spinners, pulse state transitions, and toast notifications across container actions.

title: Encrypted In-Vault SSH Keys, Drag & Drop Upload & CodeQL Hardening

changes.text: Drag-and-Drop Key Management: Added client-side FileReader parsing for SSH private keys, replacing static host filesystem path inputs.
In-Vault AES-256-GCM Encryption: Private keys are encrypted at rest using the Master PIN and decrypted strictly in memory during SSH sessions.
Automated Vault Re-encryption: Master PIN rotation now automatically re-encrypts all stored private keys, server passphrases, and AbuseIPDB keys.
CodeQL Hardening & Rate Limiting: Tiered route rate limiters and isolated static routes protect the underlying infrastructure.
Universal Portability: Eliminated host filesystem (~/.ssh) volume dependencies for Docker/AppImage and added TRUST_PROXY / RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED controls.

changes.text: PIN Reset Modal: Bound openPinReset and closePinReset to the global window scope, fully restoring modal functionality.

5-Domain Deep Audits: Expanded target capacity back to 5 concurrent domains for SSL/TLS and HTTP header audit reports.

title: Critical Security Hardening & Remote Command Confinement

changes.text: Remote Shell Injection Defense: Enforced strict parameter allowlisting (['ip', 'subnet']) on threat defense execution pipelines, eliminating remote shell injection vectors.

Unified Key Path Confinement: Extracted a centralized key path validator (isValidKeyPath) enforcing strict directory boundaries across SSH connections, Nmap pivots, Deep Batch pivots, and server save routines.
